1. **The "Lead Magnet" Scaling Gap:** Competitors like @aryamanupmanyu and @dhavalkataria_ utilize "Comment [Keyword]" loops to drive massive algorithmic signals. ### RECOMMENDED ACTIONS (Next 7 Days)

2. **Shift to "Power of X" Short-Form:** Create a 15-second video demonstrating the "Power of [Specific AI Tool]" using a high-energy, rapid-cut editing style. Mirror the success of @favourite.engineer by focusing on the *result* of the tool rather than the process.
